title: Pin Unfold back to rc.112 until rc.114 has a chart and a signed image

workItem.title: The rc.114 rollout stalls in the homelab cluster

pullRequests.title: fix(unfold): pin the HelmRelease back to 0.4.0-rc.112
ci: publish the chart and sign the image before the release tag

summary: Flux tried to move Unfold to 0.4.0-rc.114, but that chart version was never published and the image carries no signature, so admission refused it and the HelmRelease sat in a failed upgrade. The release is pinned back to rc.112, which runs again. The release workflow fix that stops this from recurring is open and its first CI run failed.
intent:
Get the homelab running a signed, published Unfold release again without editing the cluster by hand, and make the release workflow refuse to tag an image whose chart and signature do not exist yet.

The pin is a holding move. Renovate takes Unfold forward again once rc.115 ships with both.

changes.what: Pins spec.chart.spec.version to 0.4.0-rc.112 and the image to its signed digest.
changes.why: rc.114 has no chart in the registry and no cosign signature, so Flux could never finish the upgrade.

changes.what: Holds Unfold updates below 0.4.0-rc.115 until the pin is lifted.
changes.why: Without it Renovate would reopen the rc.114 update the next morning.

changes.what: Publishes the chart and signs the image in jobs that the release tag now depends on.
changes.why: The tag used to run first, so a failed chart job still left a tagged, unsigned image behind.

evidence.claim: The 0.4.0-rc.114 chart was never published to the registry.
evidence.detail: The registry answers 404 for the rc.114 tag; rc.112 and rc.113 resolve.

evidence.claim: The rc.114 image has no cosign signature.
Admission refused the unsigned rc.114 image.
Flux reconciled the pin and the HelmRelease is Ready on 0.4.0-rc.112.
The running pod's image digest equals the signed rc.112 digest.

source.ref: kubectl get pod -n unfold -l app.kubernetes.io/name=unfold -o jsonpath='{..imageID}'

evidence.detail: Checked before the node drain at 13:50; the pod was rescheduled since and nobody checked again.

evidence.claim: The release workflow now publishes the chart and signs the image before it tags.
evidence.detail: The signing job could not read the cosign key: the runner's token lacks the scope for it. The tag job correctly did not run.

evidence.claim: The Preview Environment for the workflow change serves the sign-in page.

risks.risk: The pin stays after rc.115 ships and the homelab drifts behind.
risks.mitigation: The Renovate hold expires with rc.115; the follow-up Work Item lifts the pin.

risks.risk: rc.112 lacks the tenancy migration rc.114 would have run, so a later upgrade runs two migrations at once.
risks.mitigation: Take a database snapshot before the rc.115 upgrade and read both migrations first.

risks.risk: Granting the runner the signing scope widens what a compromised workflow can sign.
risks.mitigation: Scope the token to the release workflow on tags only.

rollout.step: Merge the pin to 0.4.0-rc.112 in homelab-cluster.
rollout.check: The pull request is merged and Flux picked up its commit.

rollout.step: Confirm the running image is the signed rc.112 digest.
rollout.check: The pod's imageID equals the digest cosign verifies.

rollout.step: Fix the release workflow so the tag waits for the chart and the signature.
rollout.check: A release run publishes, signs and then tags, in that order.
helm show chart for rc.115 exits 0.

rollout.step: Let Renovate open the rc.115 update and merge it.
rollout.check: The HelmRelease is Ready on rc.115 and the running digest matches the signed one.

rollback: Revert the homelab-cluster pin commit; Flux returns to the previous HelmRelease spec.
If the pod does not come back, suspend the HelmRelease and roll the Deployment back to the last Ready ReplicaSet through a commit, not kubectl.
Lift the Renovate hold only after the pin is gone.

decisions.question: Keep the pin until rc.115, or admit rc.114 with a policy exception?
options: Keep the pin and wait for rc.115 with a chart and a signature.
Add a one-off admission exception for the unsigned rc.114 digest.
decisions.recommendation: Keep the pin. An exception teaches the cluster to admit unsigned images, and rc.112 is running.

decisions.question: Who grants the release runner the signing scope?

client.summary: The Unfold you use runs the previous release again, so sign-in and the board work as before. The newer release waits until it is built and signed properly; nothing you saved was lost.
tryThis: Sign in and open the board; your Work Items should all be there.
Open a Work Item and check its last Shift shows its pull request.
Tell us if anything you did after 12:30 today is missing.
